Show HN: I rewrote curl in Rust for fun
1283 points by ferris_admirer 4 hours ago | 412 comments

tedmiston: Cool project. How does it handle HTTP/2 push frames? The reference implementation is famously fiddly.

ferris_admirer: Right now it doesn't. The plan is to lean on hyper for the protocol layer and only implement the CLI surface myself. The HTTP/2 push semantics depend on what hyper exposes.

another_user: Curious why not just contribute to hyper-cli? Seems like a lot of duplicated effort.

ferris_admirer: hyper-cli's scope is much narrower than curl. I want all the weird flags — --resolve, --interface, --cookie-jar, --connect-to. That's not in scope for hyper-cli.

seasonedhacker: Have you compared startup time to real curl? On my box curl starts in 5ms and that's a big part of why it's nice for shell scripts.

ferris_admirer: Yes — 8ms cold, 4ms warm. The Rust version is a hair slower cold but identical warm.
